text:
Ari (partnerships): Heads up: AtlasAI wants to list an open-model bundle in our cloud marketplace. They sent an initial package but legal + infra need to agree on redistribution terms and supply-chain attestations. Adding folks here.
Sam (legal): Key legal points we need: redistribution scope (serve-only vs downloadable), allowed geos, export-classification statement, attribution, and warranty/indemnity limits. Also need a simple addendum for marketplace listing.
Priya (product): From product side: marketplace needs a small manifest + SBOM-like provenance file and a signed provenance statement from AtlasAI. For hosted variants we require a model-id mapping and a fallback policy to a Redwood-hosted compatible variant.
Dev (eng-partner): Integration notes: SI partners (HWCo, NorthLane SI) will run a compatibility suite. We need artifacts in two forms: 1) container image (OCI) with entrypoint /serve, 2) weights tarball with tokenizer. CI-bot will run smoke tests.
AtlasAI (partner): We can produce: 1) int8 quantized weights, 2) OCI image, 3) provenance.zip containing signed manifest, sbom.json, and legal_cert.pdf. We ask that Redwood allow co-branded marketplace tile and a short embargo until joint announcement.
Tom (hw-si): For our SI validation we need a per-architecture build matrix (x86_64 CUDA, four-T4, arm64 Neon) and a sample inference workload (10 prompts). Also need a compatibility note for fused-kernel expectations.
Sam (legal): Co-branding ok with MOA. Embargo needs explicit dates in addendum. Also require partner warranty that third-party components (tokenizers, tokenizer vocab) are redistributable under declared licenses.
Priya (product): Manifest fields we need (compact): model_id, version, artifact_type, quantization, weights_sha256, provenance_url, export_class. Example line: model_id: atlasai-3.0-q8
Dev (eng-partner): CI plan: ci-bot will run 1) checksum verification, 2) smoke generate (python runtime), 3) tokenization parity check, 4) simple perf sanity (p50 < 350ms on a test A100). We'll produce a small YAML job in repo redwood/partners/atlasai.
ci-bot: created job: partners/atlasai/validate-manifest.yml 
Ari (partnerships): Proposed timeline: AtlasAI uploads artifacts by Mon 9am PT, Sam posts addendum draft by Fri, CI green by Tue. Is that doable?
AtlasAI (partner): Yes, we'll upload and sign provenance.zip by Mon. We'll include a short README with health endpoint and expected ports.
Tom (hw-si): We'll run SI smoke tests once artifacts are in staging. Two asks: include a minimal Dockerfile that doesn't require rebuilding heavy deps, and include a small native build for arm64 if possible.
Sam (legal): I'll include a de-listing clause and a narrow redistribution license: non-exclusive, no sublicensing, attribution required, and documented geo-restrictions. Also adding an export compliance representation.
Priya (product): Also add a rollback plan: marketplace will temporarily mark tile as "blocked" and route traffic to Redwood-hosted variant until issues resolved.
Dev (eng-partner): Noted. I'll wire the orchestrate-lite harness to run tokenization parity across python and a small C++ binary. Exit 0 pass, 1 fail.
Ari (partnerships): Action items: AtlasAI: upload artifacts; Sam: draft addendum + MOA placeholders; Dev: CI jobs + harness; Priya: manifest validator; Tom: SI test plan. Sync Monday 10am PT.
AtlasAI (partner): Acknowledged. Thanks everyone!
Priya (product): One small note: add a manifest key "marketplace_tile_text" (<= 250 chars) for marketing to review.
Sam (legal): adding field and a short marketing sign-off clause.
ci-bot: staging bucket created: s3://redwood-partners/atlasai/1767991234/ (presign to follow)
Ari (partnerships): Great. I'll open the GH folder redwood/partners/atlasai-onboard and drop a checklist. Ping here if anything slips.
